west_egg_chamber.exit: west door x 15 (5.3 x 3.75) -> tunnel 0x102 -> corner 0x101 (Ripper at 12.9, 8136.2) -> north 0x103 -> dead-end 0x100 with the portal

obstacles.cell: see eo_fpv_route.json doors/cells; list printed in the report

speed_plan.move: hover at the drop facing NE, punch up between/over the two big props (AC1 top 4.46, hall ceiling 9) to ~6.5 m, cut throttle, float-drop over the mound crest (z 3) into the trench at 1.5 m
tunnel 0x374 (vent slalom), nose-down dive on ramp 0x373, -6 tunnels with 3 Slashers (2.33 m tall, 1.4 m headroom -> pass LEFT/RIGHT), second ramp 0x34F to -12

speed_plan.v: 7-8 (5.5-6 in the 90 deg chamfered corners, 3.65 m wide)
speed_plan.move: -12 serpentine: 16 heading changes of 45 deg, banked; 4 Slashers in the tunnel (0x307, 0x2D6: right lane only; 0x2F2, 0x2E2: either side); slim vent column in 0x308. Hidden-cut candidate.
trench 0x2C8 -> POP UP out of the mound into the 30x30x9 m Slasher hall (5 Slashers around), climb to ~-5 (ceiling -3)
cut throttle over the 6.4 x 5.9 m floor hole, nose-down 33 deg along the chute, recover into the -18 tunnel mouth (3.1-3.75 m tall)

-18/-24/-30/-36 tunnels with 3 ramp dives; 8 Slayers (2.56 m tall, 1.2 m headroom -> side lanes only, gaps 1.0-2.2 m: 0x29E/0x20A right, 0x235/0x1F1/0x1E4 left). Longest stretch: speed-ramp or hidden cut at a ramp.

-36 hall (6 m tall rooms): CHIMNEY A over 0x1E0 - punch straight up ~15 m (lid -12), cut, float, drop back; fly OVER the 2 Rippers in 0x1DE (4.1 m headroom); optional yaw-spin rise in chimney B (0x1DC); over the Ripper in 0x1D8
THE PIT: roll out over the edge at -33 (lid only 3 m above), split-S / inverted dive 18 m down the 10x10 shaft, pull out at ~-51 over the 2 Rippers, exit south through 0x1AA into tunnel 0x1AC

-54 lower-half tunnels; 7 Rippers in the corridor (1.86 m tall, 1.9 m headroom -> OVER is possible at 2.8-3.0 m, or sides 1.5-2.0 m); go round the 2.4 x 3.0 m vent column in X-junction 0x163. Hidden-cut candidate.
POP UP out of trench 0x152 straight over the Ripper in 0x153, swoop down the 31 deg ramp hall 0x150 (20 m wide, ceiling -45) past the Ripper at (79.8, 8117.0, -57)

over the Ripper in 0x12F, DIVE into trench 0x130, tunnel, POP UP 0x122->0x121, DIVE 0x11A->0x11B, tunnel 0x111 (vent slalom), chamfered corner 0x10A -> REVEAL the west egg chamber: float up to ~-53 (ceiling -48) over the eggs, larvae and hive, carve round, exit west 0x102, over the Ripper in corner 0x101, turn north and push into the portal swirl at (9.70, 8142.69)
